ns2:section.sectionText: This is an online, asynchronous course designed specifically for undergraduate NRES majors. There are weekly assignments with due dates but no specific meeting time. If all seats are full, complete the form at http://go.illinois.edu/NRESwaitinglist to be added to the waiting list.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Natural Resrcs & Environ Sci or Natural Resource Conservation major(s) or minor(s).
